name: Runs Package
description: This program is this package: the root of the program's dependency closure, the package whose code is the program itself. The packages the program consumes are everything reachable from the root along REQUIRES_PACKAGE, so one edge reaches the whole closure and no edge is drawn to a package that is only reachable through another. A program may have more than one root and a package may be the root of more than one program. A reference, not containment: a package outlives the program that names it. The SBOM does not say which package is the program, so the parser draws none; whoever knows the pairing (a seed, a collector, a person) draws it.
